community_list_entries.name: PM-Bench: Evaluating Prospective Memory in LLM Agents

phase1_classification.kind_reason: A prospective-memory benchmark: a simulated 7-day week with 83 time- and event-based deferred intentions, cross-day tasks, and 11 update events that cancel, override or reschedule tasks, plus hidden state channels to monitor. It tests remembering future intentions, which none of the 8 types cover.
